name: Desperate Prayer
summary: High Priest Rohan sends you from Ironforge to Stormwind to learn healing and survival. There, High Priestess Laurena teaches dwarven acolytes the deeper mysteries of the Church.

sections.title: A Summons to Stormwind
sections.body: In Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Rohan guides dwarven initiates devoted to the Holy Light. Seeing your discipline and faith, he sends you southwest to Stormwind. Human and dwarven clerics share close spiritual ties, and the city's grand halls hold advanced teaching.

sections.title: The Cathedral of Light
sections.body: You reach Stormwind by the Deeprun Tram and climb to Cathedral Square. In the Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena tests you on the Church's behalf. She teaches the desperate prayers a priest calls upon in battle, seeking divine aid when strength fails and death draws near.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: High Priest Rohan sends you. He leads the dwarven clergy in the Hall of Mysteries, in Ironforge's Mystic Ward.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to complete this?
faq.answer: Go to the Cathedral of Light in the heart of Cathedral Square, Stormwind City. High Priestess Laurena waits inside the main sanctuary.

faq.q: What is the best way to get to Stormwind from Ironforge?
faq.answer: Take the Deeprun Tram, built by the gnomes, from eastern Ironforge to Stormwind's Dwarven District.

faq.q: Why must a dwarf priest go to a human city to train?
faq.answer: The Church of the Holy Light is rooted in human tradition, and the Cathedral of Light is its chief seat of learning. Dwarven and human priesthoods work together, sharing teachings and traditions across the Alliance.

faq.q: What ability does this training unlock?
faq.answer: This training begins your study of Desperate Prayer. It is an instant plea for self-preservation that rapidly restores a priest's health in dire danger.
No combat is involved. You travel safely from Ironforge to Stormwind as an emissary and present yourself to High Priestess Laurena.

angles.text: As a priest, you leave Ironforge's local training and enter the wider hierarchy of the Church of the Holy Light.
As a young Khaz Modan dwarf, your journey to Stormwind offers an early glimpse of human culture, grand architecture and shared spiritual devotion.
As an Alliance member, you see Ironforge and Stormwind's spiritual bond in the way their priesthoods share training and work together.
